# GTP-U, the PDU Session Container and NR-U: compliance register

What this is: the requirements of this area that are built and verified against running code, the typed rows recorded while building them, and coverage counts derived from the specs (verification.md §5). Requirements are in [`requirements.md`](../../requirements.md); deviations in [`deviations.md`](../deviations.md).

Specs read: TS 29.281 j20, TS 38.415 j10, TS 38.425 j10.

Row suffixes (requirements.md): -D defect in the sim, -B a choice the spec leaves open, -G declared gap, -V deviation from a "shall", -S spec contradiction and the reading chosen, -M mutant, -T T0 reading or measurement, -F a kaluza-core defect the sim found, -X retired. ## Typed rows

| Row | Date | What | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|
| KS-GTPU-T1 | 2026-10-14 | M12 check (tests/oracles/oracle.py m12roundtrip) of every v1 GTP-U (7), PDU Session Container (2) and NR-U (2) type: 41 corpus vectors from OCUDU (BSD; 8 of them ones its own tests expect to be refused) and 22 values generated from TS 29.281, 38.415 and 38.425 (GTP-U min values are pycrate's defaults). Ours decodes and re-encodes byte for byte; pycrate reads the same GTP-U header, extension chain and IEs and re-encodes the PDU, and reads the PSC in an extension header; tshark finds nothing wrong, and its gtp, PSC and nrup fields hold our values (compared by their raw octets). 63 checks: 47 PASS, 8 ORACLE_LAG (KS-GTPU-T2), 6 NEGATIVE_AGREED and 2 LENIENT (KS-GTPU-T3), 0 FAIL. Must-fail mutations in CI | build/oracle/m12roundtrip.tsv, tests/oracles/ksimoracle/m12rt.py, M12 |
| KS-GTPU-T2 | 2026-10-14 | Oracle limits seen in M12. pycrate 0.8.1 misreads a chain of GTP-U extension headers: it reads every header as the first one's type and loses the next types and the PSC's QFI (OCUDU's Error Indication with a PSC and a UDP Port header, and its G-PDU with PDCP PDU Number and PSC), so it is not consulted for a PDU with more than one extension header. pycrate 0.8.1 and tshark 4.6.4 lack the Rel-17 IEs GTP-U Tunnel Status Information (230) and Recovery Time Stamp (231): pycrate keeps the first such IE and stops, tshark calls it an unknown extension header; and tshark 4.6.4 does not dissect a Tunnel Status message (253) at all. Each is matched by a rule that names it (ORACLE_LAG); Tunnel Status is checked by our round trip and pycrate's header reading only. tshark's nrup shows no BSSize, TTNB, new IE flags or retransmission fields, which are therefore not compared | tests/oracles/ksimoracle/m12rt.py, M12 |
| KS-GTPU-T3 | 2026-10-14 | Corpus (plan M12): 14 GTP-U PDUs from OCUDU's tests (gtpu_test_shared.h, gtpu_tunnel_nru_test.cpp), 4 of the 7 types; two arrays that are not GTP-U PDUs (the inner IP packet, a PDCP PDU) are excluded by shape (version 1, PT 1, Length covering the rest). OCUDU vectors now carry their test's name, and a mark when that test asserts its own unpacker refuses them: 8 NR-U vectors. Ours refuses the 6 that are malformed (invalid PDU type, a block count beyond the frame) and takes 2 that differ only after the last field (no padding; padding beyond 3 octets), which TS 38.425 5.5.1 lets a receiver take as padding or a Future Extension (LENIENT) | tests/vectors/gtpu/index.tsv, tests/vectors/nru/index.tsv, tools/corpus_ingest.py, M12 |
| KS-GTPU-S1 | 2026-10-14 | TS 38.415 j10 figure 5.5.2.1-1 puts the Rel-18 BSSI and TTNBI flags in the octet that carries PPI, which is present '0 or 1' times while only PPP announces it. The reading chosen: the octet is present when PPP is set, so BSSize and TTNB can only be signalled with a PPI. tshark 4.6.4 reads PPI the same way and has no BSSize or TTNB field; no other oracle reads them yet | src/codec/up/frames.cpp, M12 |
| KS-GTPU-B1 | 2026-10-14 | GTP-U keeps the header as received (spare bit, and the optional part's fields whose flag is clear, which 5.1 says not to evaluate), the extension chain by type with contents as octets, and IEs by Table 8.1-1 (TV of fixed length, TLV with a two-octet length, the Extension Header Type List with a one-octet count; an unknown TV IE cannot be skipped and is an error). The PSC and NR-U frames are one table-driven reader and writer: each field names the flag bit that announces it, some fields are further flag octets, some are a count of fixed-size blocks; what follows the last field is kept, and a built frame is padded to 4n-2 octets | src/codec/up/gtpu.hpp, src/codec/up/frames.hpp, tests/unit/up/up_test.cpp, M12 |
| KS-GTPU-G1 | 2026-10-14 | Kept small in P0: NR-U ASSISTANCE INFORMATION DATA (PDU type 2) is not in the frame tables (decode says unsupported); the contents of extension headers other than the PSC and NR RAN Container (RAN and Xw RAN Container, PDCP PDU numbers, UDP Port, PDU Set Information) and of the GTP-U IEs stay octets. Independent coverage: GTP-U 4/7, PSC 1/2 (OCUDU has no UL vector), NR-U 2/2 types have an OCUDU vector; the rest are generated (same decision as KS-PLAT-G2) | build/oracle/m12roundtrip.tsv, M12 |
